title: Provide canonical identities, aliases, and relationships for runtime discovery
description:
Provide pack-side stable identities, aliases, topics, and many-to-many relationships
that help runtime discovery find potentially governing material without exact kind/title
lookup. Do not make this a universal search-completeness requirement. Relationships are
discovery reasons, not exclusive ownership.
design:
2026-10-10 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main 013ec704). Profile: semantic-system (discovery architecture) within rules-clause-complete. Consumers: packages/core/src/discovery/signals.ts (name-mention extraction), candidates.ts, expansion/retention/packet, shadow traces and measurements (ambiguousNames), discovery probes (test/discovery/discoveryProbes.test.ts M1 must-consider / M3 no lost routes), lookup_rules (already returns kind-aware candidate lists on ambiguity).
D1 AMBIGUOUS NAME-MENTION DROPS THE ROUTE (demonstrated discovery defect, AC4): signals.ts (~L149-188) pushes an AmbiguousNameObservation and emits NO signal when a mentioned name maps to more than one record key (77 colliding display names at main, e.g. hide = action:hide | equipment:hide; shield = equipment:shield | spell:shield; acolyte; druid; mounts creature vs equipment; potion of healing; ability score improvement x12). So player input naming such a thing surfaces nothing by name. Repair: emit a name-mention signal for EVERY matching key, each carrying evidence {matchedName, kind, ambiguousWith: [the sibling keys]} as a retrieval reason (ADR 0020 many-to-many: several paths may surface several clauses; the DM disambiguates). Keep the ambiguousNames observation for traces. Do not invent ranking by kind; if the existing ranking/retention budget needs a rule for multi-candidate mentions, keep every candidate within retention unless an existing documented budget forbids it, and report. Verify M1/M3 probes stay green and add a probe/test: player input 'I hide' yields action:hide (and equipment:hide) as candidates with the ambiguity reason; a unique name is unchanged.
D2 F-22 display-name qualification: verify that every consumer that shows a colliding name to the DM shows kind and source with it (lookup_rules candidate summaries; packet rendering). If yes, disposition accepted with that evidence (qualification lives in presentation, not a pack field); if any consumer renders a bare colliding name, qualify it there.
D3 SENSE DEFINITION PAIRS (absorbed 19.3.6): rule:senses-darkvision (p.257) vs rule:darkvision (p.86) and the truesight/blindsight/tremorsense pairs are distinct texts, not duplicates; do not alias. If D1 makes a name-mention surface both, that already satisfies discovery; otherwise record that no relation is emitted and why.
D4 dispositions: CAP-011 canonical-discovery (canonical relationships and discovery durable) and fable:F8 rule-key-duplication (rule keying and duplication hygiene explicit): check rule records with the same or near-same titles (e.g. rule:spellcasting / rule:spellcasting-chapter / rule:special-traits-spellcasting) for true duplication vs distinct passages; repair a true duplicate, otherwise disposition with evidence. Registry rows updated with reasoning. EXCLUSIONS: no universal retrieval-completeness claim; no alias table invented without a source or consumer need.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known duplicate names and represented option identities resolve to stable unambiguous identities.
- Runtime discovery can consume aliases/topics/relationships without exact normalized kind/title.
- Relationship metadata preserves multiple meaningful retrieval reasons rather than exclusive neighborhoods.
- A demonstrated missing alias/index entry can be a discovery defect; absence from an index never proves irrelevance or source absence.
- This bead makes no universal retrieval-completeness claim.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
pre-ADR global-closure language in older notes. Historical notes remain evidence,
not current authority.
ADR-0020 disposition pass 2026-09-22 (eshyra-o9bd.19 rebaseline): KEPT - discovery-side identities/aliases (recovery step 3); sequence after the Lane A source repairs so aliases are built on corrected records.
2026-10-09 rebaseline: absorbs retired eshyra-o9bd.19.3.6. Parallel sense definitions across chapters (rule:senses-darkvision p.257 vs rule:darkvision p.86, and the truesight/blindsight/tremorsense pairs) are not duplicates - the texts differ and match the PDF - so they must not be aliased as one identity. If a discovery consumer needs to surface both, express it here as a source-supported many-to-many relationship (a retrieval reason, not ownership or duplicate-of); otherwise record that no relation is emitted. Do not infer edges from audit ownership or canonicalOwner.
